name: test-hud
description: Test runs at a glance: passing over total in the status line, a sparkline of failures across runs, the failing tests, and a toast when the suite turns green

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Track test runs: the status line, the pane and the toasts. Off keeps only the /test-hud command, which turns it back on. /test-hud on and off change it too; /test-hud hide keeps it on but silent

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.description: Draw nothing by itself, as hide does, and keep the command and the pane. /pad quiet on and off set it in every mod at once. Errors, permission requests and the agent's questions are never hidden

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane, the status line and the toasts. auto follows the system's LANG: Portuguese for pt_*, English otherwise and when LANG is unset

regressionToast.title: Toast when tests turn red
regressionToast.description: Also show a toast when a runner turns red right after a green run

keepHistory.title: Keep runs across sessions
keepHistory.description: Keep the last runs per project in the plugin's store, so the next session in the same project starts with them
